title: A Hollow for the Oath Anew
author: Beatrix Vane
blurb: Felix Okonkwo, an exiled storm-caller, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
